project_info.color_palette: Shopee orange, vivid green, blue, sand beige, black

main_subject.detail: A summer-themed banking promo with Shopee and VPBank logos at top left and a sale badge 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG' at top right. A large blue discount pill reads 'GIAM DEN 200.000 DONG'. The lower green panel shows several VPBank cards arranged on a beach with tropical palm trees and cartoon fruit characters. Visible cards include black VPBank travel cards, a scenic teal VISA debit card, and a black diamond card. Sand, beach props, and playful fruit mascots decorate the scene.
main_subject.style: Playful summer fintech poster with card-collage centerpiece, tropical illustration panel, and oversized savings typography
